column1: # address regions: 2026-10-29, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +62.06 GB, within the profile's 64.00 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite ceddb1ec254f)
# Unreal's texture streamer writes each streamed mip level straight into the texture's storage, in CPU_UNCACHED pools (flags 0xe2) that need no flush, after the
# texture is created; without both keys those textures kept stale or zero blocks (random-colour mosaics on armour, tree trunks and ground, a black Gohan), as Yoshi's Crafted World
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the cap is rhi.SyncInterval 2 (DefaultEngine.ini) and t.MaxFPS 30 (set at run time; bUseFixedFrameRate=False), which hle_fpslock.c rewrites
# for this build; movement and voice triggers keep their speed (delta time). DM_FPS_TARGET=30 in the settings window keeps the game's own rate
# The application pool reported under a preset (ue_quality.tsv): Unreal's allocator budgets against it, and the Switch's 3.21 GB does not fit 4K targets (docs/agents/07-quality.md)

# The game sets near = 0, so the app's offline archive takes the main0_z vertex entries; without this key its bases were made for near = -w and could not stand in for a draw, and the device had to prebuild them itself
